description: NaSb₃F₁₀ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are three shorter (2.29 Å) and three longer (2.30 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Sb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five F atoms. There are a spread of Sb-F bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.48 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent Sb atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Sb atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Sb atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Sb atoms.
